assistant|vinyl_tip: Start with albums you already know and love
Invest in a good turntable, phono preamp and speakers for best sound quality
Handle records by the edges, never touch the surface, store upright in protective sleeves
Clean records regularly with a soft cloth and gentle cleaning solution
Explore different genres and eras to find hidden gems
Check condition carefully when buying used records - look for scratches, warping, damage
Join a vinyl community - online forums, social media groups, local record stores
Be patient and persistent - collecting can be a hunt for rare records
Visit record stores, attend record swaps, explore Discogs or eBay for new additions
Enjoy the tactile experience, artwork and nostalgia - not just the music
